odc_type: Boundary condition violation in adaptive step size calculation
observation_summary: The integrator attempts to evaluate the differential equations at a time point outside the specified integration range, causing assertion failures or incorrect integration results.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the adaptive step size integrator calculates an initial step size that can exceed the total integration range when the range is very short. The integrator fails to truncate this step size to fit within the target time boundary, leading to function evaluations outside the valid integration interval. The fix introduces a check to ensure that the calculated step size does not overshoot the target time 't' in either the forward or backward integration direction.
